comments.content: Secret written to logs: the full raw API token is logged on every rejection. Rejected tokens are often real credentials (expired, revoked, wrong-scope, a near-miss typo, or a valid token that failed a transient parse/verify), and the parse error may echo token contents too. Anyone with log access can harvest them. Log only the rejection reason plus a non-reversible identifier (e.g. a short SHA-256 fingerprint or the token's key ID/last 4 chars), never the token itself.
